question.worked_solution:
Let $f(x)=2{x}^{5}-8{x}^{4}+24{x}^{2}-16.$ The slope of the tangent at $x=3$ is equal to ${f}^{′}(3).$ Computing the derivative, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{5}-8{x}^{4}+24{x}^{2}-16) \\  & =2\cdot 5{x}^{4}-8\cdot 4{x}^{3}+24\cdot 2x-0 \\  & =10{x}^{4}-32{x}^{3}+48x.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we evaluate at $x=3$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(3) & =10({3}^{4})-32({3}^{3})+48(3) \\  & =810-864+144 \\  & =90.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the slope $m$ of the tangent to the curve at $x=3$ is

$$
m={f}^{′}(3)=90.
$$
